claims.text: Rh typing and RhIG ⍉required b4 12 wks
claims.quote: Rh typing and RhIG are not required prior to 12 weeks of gestation; data has demonstrated that the amount of blood required for fetomaternal hemorrhage and thus sensitization is not transferred prior to 12 weeks of gestation (4).

claims.text: Rh-neg @ ≥12 wks: give RhIG after the procedure
claims.quote: After the procedure, women with Rh-negative blood at 12 weeks of gestation or later are given immune globulin.
